beats.summary: Karsemine rushes to the Academy with Winna after fearing the guards are watching the Dustwalker. beats.title: Questionable Company secures supplies through the old guard station
beats.summary: The group heads to the old guard tower and is briefly surrounded by guards while Lysandra breaks down. Stafl speaks up to get Sergeant Fabio to contact the Mayor, after which the group is escorted down to the basement to see the bursar. The bursar agrees to prepare basic travel supplies, and the group then returns to the inn and arranges for ale for the trip, with the barkeep agreeing to ask Barin on their behalf.

beats.title: Wolf Manor search reveals supplies, clues, and family-linked objects
beats.summary: Before leaving for the swamp, the group explores Wolf Manor. They find a scouting map in the library, herbs in the kitchen, a healing potion in an old bottle, and a Wolf family-sealed safe and other keepsakes in the attic. Ephanna and others also uncover strange symbols, a message addressed to Bonogo, toys, and an orb tied to the symbols.

beats.title: The crypt yields rings, a warning letter, and a hidden basement chamber
beats.summary: Bonogo explores the crypt and pries open sarcophagi, finding skeletons, an iron amulet, wolf pelts, copper rings, a stone tablet, and a wolf-shaped key from the safe. Ephanna opens the letter addressed to Bonogo and sees a warning-like message. Back in the kitchen, the wolf-head key unlocks a trap door into a basement room filled with strange symbols, a summoning circle matching the Necromancer’s, and the smell of cooked meat, with a tunnel leading toward the city.

beats.title: Returning to the Academy ends with Blizzy’s potion dispute
beats.summary: After deciding not to pursue the hidden room, the group returns to the Academy and reconnects with Torbin and Caelynn. They then encounter Blizzy arguing with Winna over payment for a large potion order. Stafl tries Suggestion on Winna and fails, so the group needs Headmaster Tinkerbright to authorize payment; Stafl then reassures Blizzy and keeps the cart of potions for later handling.
